channels.name: 🆘｜help
channels.topic: Something not working? Pick the app in the tags and say what happened: the app's version, your Windows or device version, what you clicked and the exact error. For Guardian attach the end of %LOCALAPPDATA%\Guardian\errors.log if there is an error.

channels.name: 🐞｜bug-reports

channels.name: 💡｜feature-requests
channels.topic: Have an idea? One idea per post, pick the app, and say what problem it solves. Vote with a reaction.

channels.name: 🧪｜false-positives
channels.topic: Guardian flagged something that is fine? Post the file name, the program's publisher, where you got it, the SHA-256 and the 'why it was flagged' text. Do NOT upload files that hold personal data.
